package: QFN-28 5×5 mm, 0.5 mm pitch, exposed pad

1.name: OB2
1.hint: motor coil output (N-channel FET bridge): floating while ENN is high (2.2); short to GND and short to VS detection switches the bridge off (15.2 – 'cannot protect … for all possible short events')

2.name: ENN
2.hint: enable not: high switches the power stage off (all motor outputs floating) and resets a driver error; no internal pull stated – drive it (2.2)

4.name: CPO
4.hint: charge pump: a 22 nF 50 V capacitor between CPO and CPI (2.2)

5.name: CPI
5.hint: charge pump: a 22 nF 50 V capacitor between CPO and CPI (2.2)

needs.source: TMC2209 datasheet Rev. 1.03 (2019-06-26), pin table: CPI 'Tie to CPO using 22nF 50V capacitor', VCP 'Tie to VS using 100nF capacitor' – the values read as the minimum

6.name: VCP
6.hint: charge pump voltage: a 100 nF (16 V) capacitor from VCP to VS, not to GND (2.2, figure 3.1)

needs.source: TMC2209 datasheet Rev. 1.03 (2019-06-26), pin table: CPI 'Tie to CPO using 22nF 50V capacitor', VCP 'Tie to VS using 100nF capacitor' – the values read as the minimum

7.name: SPREAD
7.hint: low = StealthChop, high = SpreadCycle; internal pull-down, may be left unconnected (2.2)

8.name: 5VOUT
8.hint: internal 5 V regulator (4.80 … 5.25 V): 25 mA max including the internal load, (VS − 5 V) × I ≤ 0.5 W (19); may supply VCC_IO

needs.source: TMC2209 datasheet Rev. 1.03, 2.2 signal descriptions and 21.3 supply filtering: a 2.2 … 4.7 µF ceramic capacitor (6.3 V in figure 3.1) to GND near the pin, shortest loop to the die pad

9.name: MS1_AD0
9.hint: microstep setting MS2, MS1: 00 1/8, 01 1/32, 10 1/64, 11 1/16; in UART mode bit 0 of the UART address (2.2, 4)

10.name: MS2_AD1
10.hint: microstep setting (with MS1); in UART mode bit 1 of the UART address (2.2, 4)

11.name: DIAG
11.hint: high on stall detection or driver error (2.2)

13.name: CLK
13.hint: tie to GND with a short wire for the internal 12 MHz clock, or feed an external clock 4 … 16 MHz (2.2, 18)

14.name: PDN_UART
14.hint: power down not (low = automatic standstill current reduction) and optional single-wire UART, 9000 baud … fCLK/16 (2.2, 4)

15.name: VCC_IO
15.hint: 3.3 … 5 V I/O supply for all digital pins; the inputs' protection diodes do not let them rise above it (17)

needs.source: TMC2209 datasheet Rev. 1.03, figure 3.1 standard application circuit: 100 nF at VCC_IO

17.name: VREF
17.hint: analog current scaling, linear 0 … 5VOUT/2 (open: 5VOUT/2, 260–400 kΩ to 2.5 V); do not exceed VCC_IO and 5VOUT by more than 10 % – that enables a test mode (19, 20.2)

20.name: STDBY
20.hint: high = standby, internal regulator off; 100 kΩ pull-down, may be left unconnected; also bring VREF and ENN to 0 V in standby (2.2)

21.name: OA2
21.hint: motor coil output (N-channel FET bridge): floating while ENN is high (2.2); short to GND and short to VS detection switches the bridge off (15.2 – 'cannot protect … for all possible short events')

22.name: VS
22.hint: motor supply: 5.5 … 29 V with the internal 5 V regulator (4.7 … 5.4 V with 5VOUT bridged to VS); 32 V absolute maximum with inductive load, 33 V peak – leave margin for ringing (19)

needs.source: TMC2209 datasheet Rev. 1.03, 21.3 supply filtering: an electrolytic of 47 µF or larger and a ceramic capacitor close to the VS pins (3.1: a minimum of 100 µF near the driver for best performance; figure 3.1: 100 µF low-ESR plus 2 × 100 nF)

23.name: BRA
23.hint: sense resistor to GND close to the pin (low-inductance SMD, e.g. 1206 0.5 W), its own ground via; tie to GND for internal sensing (2.2, 21.2)

24.name: OA1
24.hint: motor coil output (N-channel FET bridge): floating while ENN is high (2.2); short to GND and short to VS detection switches the bridge off (15.2 – 'cannot protect … for all possible short events')

25.name: UNUSED
25.hint: unused – may be connected to GND for better routing (2.2)

26.name: OB1
26.hint: motor coil output (N-channel FET bridge): floating while ENN is high (2.2); short to GND and short to VS detection switches the bridge off (15.2 – 'cannot protect … for all possible short events')

27.name: BRB
27.hint: sense resistor to GND close to the pin (low-inductance SMD, e.g. 1206 0.5 W), its own ground via; tie to GND for internal sensing (2.2, 21.2)

28.name: VS
28.hint: motor supply: 5.5 … 29 V with the internal 5 V regulator (4.7 … 5.4 V with 5VOUT bridged to VS); 32 V absolute maximum with inductive load, 33 V peak – leave margin for ringing (19)

29.name: EP
29.hint: exposed die pad: ground of the power drivers and the analog circuitry – to the GND plane with as many vias as possible (2.2, 21.1)

absolute maximum 19 p. 72: VS -0.5 … 32 V operating with inductive load (VS v_max_v; 33 V supply and bridge maximum), VCC_IO -0.5 … 5.5 V (vdd_max_v, VCC_IO v_max_v), logic inputs -0.5 V … VCC_IO + 0.5 V (vin_rel_max_v 0.5), VREF -0.5 … 6 V, digital pins ±10 mA, 5VOUT 25 mA and 0.5 W, output current 3 A repetitive, TJ -50 … 150 °C

operational range 20.1 p. 72: TJ -40 … 125 °C (tj_max_c 125), VS 5.5 … 29 V with the internal regulator (VS v_op), VCC_IO 3.00 … 5.25 V (vdd_op_min_v, vdd_op_max_v – VCC_IO carries the role vdd), RMS coil current 1.4 A per coil as design guideline (i_out_max_a; 2.0 A with duty-cycle limit), peak 2.8 A

DC characteristics 20.2 pp. 73–76: IS 10 mA max with driver disabled at fCLK 12 MHz, VS 24 V (idd_max_a), RDSON low and high side 0.17 typ / 0.21 Ω max at 200 mA, 25 °C (r_out_ohm), input low ≤ 0.3 VVIO, high ≥ 0.7 VVIO (vil_ratio, vih_ratio), outputs VOL 0.2 V / VOH VVIO − 0.2 V at 2 mA, pull-up/pull-down 132 / 166 / 200 kΩ, STDBY pull-down 80 / 100 / 120 kΩ, 5VOUT 4.80 … 5.25 V
rth_ja_k_per_w 30: 20.3 table 20.1, RTMJA on a 2s2p JEDEC board (RTJC 6 K/W)
address: 4 UART single wire interface p. 15 – 'the slave address SLAVEADDR is selected by MS1 (bit 0) and MS2 (bit 1)', SLAVEADDR = 0 … 3 on PDN_UART

capacitors: 2.2 signal descriptions (CPI–CPO 22 nF 50 V, VCP–VS 100 nF, 5VOUT 2.2 … 4.7 µF ceramic), figure 3.1 (VCC_IO 100 nF, VS 100 µF low ESR + 2 × 100 nF), 3.1 text (≥ 100 µF near the driver for best performance), 21.3 supply filtering (VS 47 µF or larger electrolytic plus ceramic)
LCSC product data C2150710 (2026-10-31): ADI/TRINAMIC TMC2209-LA-T, QFN-28-EP(5x5), 19 495 pcs; JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31: Extended Part, 21 811 pcs
notes: Bipolar stepper driver with STEP/DIR and single-wire UART, VS 5.5–29 V (32 V abs. max with inductive load), 1.4 A RMS per coil, VCC_IO 3–5 V; StealthChop/SpreadCycle, StallGuard. Up to four on one UART line, addressed by MS1_AD0/MS2_AD1 (maker-coverage CK-3). Logic inputs must not rise above VCC_IO + 0.5 V – input protection diodes (17). Mostly bought as a StepStick-format module (BIGTREETECH, FYSETC, TRINAMIC TMC2209 SilentStepStick C17375345) – this entry is the IC. No behaviour model for a bridge driver: behavior none. Library draft.

2026-10-31: bridge outputs drive = bridge – the H-bridge outputs the datasheet of this draft describes (source above): driven high or low while enabled, off in sleep or coast; LEVELS counts them as defining their net (schema-gaps A2)
2026-10-31: CPI–CPO 22 nF 50 V, VCP–VS 100 nF (Rev. 1.03 pin table, read now)
open: read the LCSC copy of Rev. 1.03 (2019); ADI's current Rev. 1.09 could not be fetched – differences not checked
CPI–CPO (22 nF) and VCP–VS (100 nF) capacitors are not to ground – pin hints only
VS capacitor: 47 µF (21.3) and 100 µF (3.1) are both 'recommended' – the entry takes 47 µF as the minimum
the outputs' clamping (body diodes of the output MOSFETs, named in note *) of 19) has no field; REQ.missing (flyback) asks for a diode across a motor on an output pin – here a false finding
drive tristate makes a motor net driven only by these outputs an LVL.undefined/open_drain warning – no pin type fits a bridge output
which pins besides those marked (pd) carry the 132–200 kΩ pull resistors is not stated per pin – ENN, STEP, CLK and PDN_UART are entered without a pull
logic inputs have no absolute v_max_v (VCC_IO + 0.5 V, held by vin_rel_max_v); PDN_UART is bidirectional and so outside LIM.v/inject
i_out_max_a 1.4 A is the RMS design guideline; peak and duty-cycle values are in sources only
no ambient operating temperature range in the datasheet (junction only)
